meta.title: Restrict highest_value sort to open tickets only
meta.body_summary: Restrict highest_value sort to open tickets by coordinating changes across TRPC router, frontend, and backend search to prevent infinite loading when viewing closed tickets.

perf_labels.notes: Devin's initial implementation had logical inconsistencies flagged by cursor bot; binary-koan committed a fix, and PR merged without performance benchmark.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At only 22 changed lines, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, targeted performance fix and was successfully merged after a maintainer corrected logical inconsistencies.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] flagged that the frontend array comparison `searchParams.status !== "closed"` fails to properly hide the option for closed tickets, and that the backend sort logic and TRPC router had inconsistent conditions leading to wrong default sorts.
review_details.performance_claim: Restricting highest_value sort to open tickets only prevents infinite loading on the closed tickets list.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin's initial implementation had logical flaws in coordinating conditional logic across three files, which were caught by automated review and later fixed by a human. The core problem (multi-file conditional consistency) exceeded the agent's ability to get right on the first try for this codebase.

detection_detail.code_reading: cursor[bot] performed automated code review and flagged sorting inconsistencies.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR author stated changes are untested due to local environment issues; no before/after timing evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: binary-koan committed a 'Fix' that corrected the TRPC router condition and backend sort logic to address the inconsistencies raised by cursor[bot].

core_change_summary.description: In three files, conditionally restrict the highest_value sort option to open tickets: the TRPC router only sets it as defaultSort when the input status includes 'open'; the frontend search bar hides the option when status is explicitly 'closed'; the backend search logic ensures closed-only queries default to 'newest' sort without expensive highest_value sorting.
change_trajectory: Initial commit by Devin: added conditional defaultSort in TRPC router, frontend visibility check, and backend sort default logic.
autofix-ci applied automated formatting fix on TRPC router file.
binary-koan committed 'Fix' to correct inconsistent conditions and inverted default sort behavior as flagged by cursor[bot].

review_signals.summary: Flagged that the TRPC router, frontend, and backend have inconsistent sorting logic for highest_value sort, leading to potential regressions.
Pointed out that frontend condition `searchParams.status !== 'closed'` fails to work for arrays, causing the highest_value option to appear when viewing only closed tickets.
Reported sorting regressions after merge, including inconsistent highest_value sorting and inverted default sort for non-open tickets; submitted after the PR was merged.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created by Devin with initial implementation addressing Slack-reported infinite loading issue.
cursor[bot] posted three automated reviews pointing out logical inconsistencies in conditional sorting.
binary-koan committed a manual 'Fix' to correct the defects and merged the PR shortly after.
